Amazon Pledges $7 Billion for India's Renewable Energy by 2030

Amazon has announced a commitment to invest $7 billion in India's renewable energy sector by 2030. This investment will support the procurement of renewable energy and includes the unveiling of four new projects. The company has signed new power purchase agreements totaling 934 MW with ReNew, Sunsure, and Waaree. This new pledge is in addition to $4 billion already contracted by Amazon for renewable energy in India.
